messages:
Jamie (Eng SRE): We've published the RCA for the serving latency spike from 2026-03-15. Full doc + timeline: https://redwood.internal/rca/2612349999

Priya (Product): Thanks — quick TL;DR?

Jamie (Eng SRE): TL;DR: autoscaler policy drift + cold KV-cache warmup gap -> tail latencies for medium-size requests. Impact: ~2.4% error-rate spike for 8m, no P0 customer outage. Root cause & repro steps in the doc.

Aiden (Oncall): OpsBot posted the annotated timeline and metric charts inside the doc. Section "next steps" lists owners and deliverables.

Zoe (Engineering Manager): Owner list looks reasonable. I'll own the autoscaler policy changes, target delivery 2026-04-05.

Samir (Runtime): I'll take cache warmup tuning and the small runtime patch. Can we mark this P1 for Dedicated pools?

Priya (Product): P1 makes sense. I'll coordinate customer validation and gather 3 representative flows by EOD Wed.

Jamie (Eng SRE): Assigned: Zoe -> autoscaler policy (RWD-4317), Samir -> cache warmup + runtime patch (RWD-4320), Priya -> customer validation. Dates are in the doc.

OpsBot: New RCA published by Jamie. Timeline: https://redwood.internal/rca/2612349999/timeline

Luca (SRE): Quick Q: do we have an automated perf run to validate the change? I'll schedule a canary run and capture percentiles.

Zoe (Engineering Manager): Yes Luca, please schedule a canary for 2026-03-29 and add results to the RCA doc.

Samir (Runtime): Note: runtime change is a ~12-line patch to cache warmup ordering. PR: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/987

Jamie (Eng SRE): Small config snippet we updated for the autoscaler is in the doc (example):
```
policy:
  min_replicas: 2
  target_cpu_utilization: 0.6
  scale_down_grace_period: 30s
```

Priya (Product): Also adding a regression eval in Redwood Optimize to catch this pattern. @Aiden can you coordinate the eval set?

Aiden (Oncall): Yep — will add the eval and reach out to the three customers affected for validation.

Zoe (Engineering Manager): One more ask: add an automated test that detects scaler config drift across deploys. Ticket created: RWD-4321.

Samir (Runtime): Ack, will link the PR to RWD-4321 and include test coverage.

Jamie (Eng SRE): Action checkpoint: owners' sync + status update on 2026-04-06 16:00 PT. Office hours for questions scheduled 2026-03-30 10:00 PT in #all-hands-room.

Priya (Product): :thumbsup:

Luca (SRE): :eyes:

OpsBot: Reminder set for owners on 2026-04-06.

Jamie (Eng SRE): If no objections, we'll close this thread after the 2-week checkpoint once owners confirm fixes validated. Please flag anything missing in the doc. Thanks everyone.
